items.title: UK passive equity funds record first net outflows in three years
items.summary: UK marketed passive equity funds experienced net withdrawals in November for the first time since August 2023.

items.title: Zurich UK launches life insurance advertising campaign focused on life milestones
items.summary: Zurich UK has initiated a multi-channel advertising campaign designed to reframe life protection around life milestones rather than the end of life.

items.title: Allianz Commercial plans direct underwriting syndicate at Lloyd’s for 2027
items.summary: Allianz Commercial has announced plans to launch a direct underwriting syndicate at Lloyd’s, targeting specialty and MGA business from January subject to final approval.

items.title: Insurance industry personnel moves: HDI Global, HIVE, Folgate, Gallagher, Targa, and Coversure
items.summary: Recent senior appointments and network additions across the UK insurance sector include leadership changes at HDI Global, HIVE Underwriters, Folgate, Gallagher, Targa Telematics, and AF Insurance.

items.title: Aon increases client treaty facility share to 35% for 2027
items.summary: Aon has renewed its QBE-led reinsurance facility for 2027, raising the proportion of eligible specialty and facultative placements it supports from 28.5% to 35%.

items.title: Sedgwick warns 79% of UK properties are underinsured amid repair capacity squeeze
items.summary: Claims firm Sedgwick highlights mounting vulnerabilities in the UK property market as underinsurance rates rise alongside contractor shortages.
